description: A module's performance in the time range against the same range $timeshift earlier: set the range to start at the release and compare it with the days before. Apdex = (satisfied + tolerating / 2) / requests, over screens and Reactive server calls: satisfied up to 3 s, tolerating up to 10 s, frustrated above. Both thresholds are bucket edges of atrium_outsystems_operation_duration_seconds.
